name: Optical Modeling for CFI
definition: A theoretical model calculating optical intensities for shadowgraph, schlieren, and interferometric techniques based on line-of-sight integration through a discrete three-dimensional field.
summary: Optical Modeling for CFI calculates shadowgraph, schlieren, or interferometric intensities by integrating refractive index gradients through 3D flow fields, specializing the volume rendering integral for optical diagnostics.
